name: Chaos Queen Ryouko Story #3 Moriyama Ikumi Hen
original_name: カオスQUEEN遼子 STORY#3 森山郁美編
source:
Assistant Shinichi is having a sweet dream of chasing a girl, but is woken up by Ryouko who is pleasing Shinichi. Ryouko is so starved for love that she even satisfies with man's company now. She sends Shinichi out to find new young girls in order to give them love consultation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
助手新一正在做着追逐女孩的美梦，却被正在取悦他的辽子叫醒。辽子如此渴望爱情，如今甚至满足于男性的陪伴。她派新一出去寻找新的年轻女孩，以便给她们提供恋爱咨询。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
